Senses.PreferredTarget: an adept conversant in every direction
SearchAliases: an adept whose understanding reaches in every direction
Senses.Note: The first element qualifies the adept’s reach or competence; the second names the accomplished hand, not a reader or textual parser.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The expression names an adept conversant in every direction, invited or challenged to distinguish, verify, answer, or speak.
EvidenceBody: Yuanwu invites the adept to distinguish and jointly verify the saying; other speakers challenge the adept to know, answer, or step forward and speak.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Yuanwu says such an adept can distinguish the saying or jointly verify it; other speakers call on the adept to know, answer, or step forward.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The cases praise or challenge an accomplished adept; they do not restrict the role to reading texts or to a generic practitioner.

ComparedThings: an adept whose understanding reaches in every direction
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Yuanwu invites the adept to distinguish and jointly verify the saying; other speakers challenge the adept to know, answer, or step forward and speak.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: “Adept conversant in every direction” retains both the accomplished 作者 and the unrestricted reach of 通方.

ModifierControls.Finding: Dropping the all-directions qualification loses the breadth by which the adept is invited to distinguish or verify.

FamilyControls.Term: 作者, 作家, and 明眼宗師
FamilyControls.Finding: These neighboring labels may name accomplished people, but only 通方作者 carries this exact all-directions qualification.
